thread:
priya: quick sync — drafting PRD for per-route retention + trace sampling controls. want to align on M1 scope before eng sprint planning.

jordan: +1. can we limit M1 to console toggles (7/30/90) and a trace-sampling slider? defer per-tenant policy editor and cost projections to M2

katy: FYI — customer ask from AcmeCorp: needs 1-year retention option and ability to redact PII from logs. compliance team flagged this as block for them

mike: rough storage estimate for 1y: ~3TB/month extra at current traffic -> ~ $12k/mo. needs finance validation. also affects query latency for analytics paths

natalie: UX note: retention modal should show projected cost delta and estimated query latency impact. mockups in Figma, link incoming

priya: accepting draft acceptance criteria: 1) retention toggles per-route in console (7/30/90 day presets + custom), 2) telemetry emitted on changes (event: retention.changed), 3) per-service trace sampling slider, 4) PII redaction flow defined and tested for any retention >90d

jordan: edge cases to cover in PRD: a) org reduces retention -> async GC job must remove older data and emit audit events, b) cross-region replicas must inherit retention window and GC policy, c) export/webhook behavior when data deleted

mike: rollout proposal: canary to 10% of orgs on Dedicated for 48h, monitor storage delta, query latency, and GC error rates. fallback: revert console flags and run manual GC cleanup if needed

eng-bot: deploy started for feature/retention-m1 -> env: staging -> build 0.9.3

katy: product tradeoff: if eng wants to cut scope, we can ship core toggles + sampling + audit logs in M1, postpone cost projection and 1yr retention to M2. Thoughts?

jordan: that cut makes sense. priority order: 1) toggles + sampling + audit logs, 2) PII redaction for >90d, 3) cost UI & 1y option in M2. keeps customer unblock path while limiting storage risk

priya: agreed. action items: @mike add detailed storage numbers & assumptions into PRD, @katy attach UX mocks, @jordan write GC and cross-region acceptance tests, I'll update PRD and ping for sign-off

mike: added quick calc to PRD draft: https://redwood.internal/drive/retention-prd-draft (please review assumptions)

katy: uploaded screenshots and a small flow for the modal. link: https://figma.redwood/retention-modal

priya: small schema example for telemetry we should emit on change:
```
{
  "event": "retention.changed",
  "org_id": "org_123",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "prev_days": 30,
  "new_days": 90,
  "actor": "admin@acme.com"
}
```

jordan: good. make sure audit log includes job ids for GC runs and outcome codes

priya: thanks. I'll update PRD and add a M2 section for cost UI + 1yr option. aiming for PRD draft final by EOD Fri. next sync Tue 10am. closing thread :thumbsup:
